audio.music_mood: none; tactile plastic clicks and brick disintegration sounds only

content.concept_description: A top-down sliding puzzle game where Lego-style interlocking blocks are shifted through open grid spaces to exit through matching colored perimeter gates.
content.why_it_works: Crisp tactile sound effects combined with smooth sliding movements and satisfying disintegration animations appeal to puzzle and ASMR lovers.

visuals.notable_objects: Lego-like plastic blocks, sliding perimeter slots, animated pointer hand

emotions.emotional_arc: Curiosity about the spatial block arrangement leads to satisfaction as blocks clear smoothly.

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: A simulated hand drags shaped interlocking plastic blocks into free board spaces to align them with matching color border slots, causing them to disintegrate.

chapterization.chapter_description: Hand immediately slides an orange brick into a bottom slot where it crumbles.
Hand systematically shifts blocks around the board to create pathways and clear colored pieces.
Puzzle layout repeats, highlighting the methodical spatial problem-solving steps.
